# Fourth Group & Co

> Fourth Group & Co is a global writers network for authors, poets and screenwriters. Members get verified submission opportunities, an author directory, weekly writing prompts, publishing guides and movie-adaptation pitch tools for one annual membership of $25/year. Contact: hello@fourthgroup.co

## Find opportunities
- [Contests](https://fourthgroupco.lovable.app/contests): Writing contests and competitions
- [Grants & awards](https://fourthgroupco.lovable.app/grants-awards): Funding for writers
- [Literary magazines](https://fourthgroupco.lovable.app/literary-magazines): Journals open to submissions
- [Small presses](https://fourthgroupco.lovable.app/small-presses): Publishers reading unagented work
- [Residencies](https://fourthgroupco.lovable.app/residencies): Retreats and residencies
- [Literary agents](https://fourthgroupco.lovable.app/literary-agents): Agent research
- [Short stories](https://fourthgroupco.lovable.app/short-stories): Markets for short fiction

## Learn and connect
- [Resources](https://fourthgroupco.lovable.app/resources): Guides on querying, contracts and rights
- [Writing prompts](https://fourthgroupco.lovable.app/writing-prompts): A new prompt each week
- [Author directory](https://fourthgroupco.lovable.app/directory): Member writers
- [Events](https://fourthgroupco.lovable.app/events): Readings and workshops
- [News](https://fourthgroupco.lovable.app/news): Announcements

## Screen adaptation
- [Movie adaptation](https://fourthgroupco.lovable.app/movie-adaptation): How pitching works
- [Pitch plans](https://fourthgroupco.lovable.app/pitch-plans): Pricing

## About
- [Membership](https://fourthgroupco.lovable.app/membership): $25/year, no tiers or hidden charges
- [About](https://fourthgroupco.lovable.app/about)
- [Contact](https://fourthgroupco.lovable.app/contact): hello@fourthgroup.co
